name: Application Source Creator
description: Create model-authored frontend, backend and database application files with architecture and runtime metadata.
whenToUse: 앱을 만들고 프론트엔드 백엔드 데이터베이스를 구현할 때 사용한다. Create web application frontend backend database source and architecture for deployment. Supply application-specific code and explicit requested synthetic seed scripts; this tool writes files only and never executes or publishes.

aiTools.name: app_create
aiTools.description: Write model-authored application architecture and frontend/backend/database source as a new file artifact. Include ARCHITECTURE.md in files and runtime declarations in metadata. No execution or publication.

root.description: Absolute new directory; parent must exist. Never overwrites.

metadata.description: Application runtime declarations, not execution authority. Include runtime startCommand argv, reserved port31500..31599, healthPath, frontendRoot relative directory and apiPrefix /api.

examples: Create a web application with frontend backend database and architecture

inputs.files: Relative paths and UTF-8 contents including ARCHITECTURE.md, application code and explicitly requested seed/test scripts.
inputs.metadata: Runtime declarations only; publisher separately validates owner, allowed argv/port and source authority.

outputs.artifact: source-artifact@1 with root, file SHA256 map and metadata.
outputs.status: executed:false and published:false. Runtime declarations confer no authority.

examples: Create frontend backend database source for a web application deployment.
Create database code and an explicit synthetic population script.
